topology.clear_netem:
ip netns exec c tc qdisc del dev vc root 2>/dev/null || true
ip netns exec s tc qdisc del dev vs root 2>/dev/null || true

netem.burst_loss:
ip netns exec c tc qdisc replace dev vc root netem limit 100000 loss gemodel 1% 20% 100% 0% seed 1234
ip netns exec s tc qdisc replace dev vs root netem limit 100000 loss gemodel 1% 20% 100% 0% seed 1234
netem.delay:
ip netns exec c tc qdisc replace dev vc root netem limit 100000 delay 10ms
ip netns exec s tc qdisc replace dev vs root netem limit 100000 delay 10ms
netem.loss:
ip netns exec c tc qdisc replace dev vc root netem limit 100000 loss 1% seed 1234
ip netns exec s tc qdisc replace dev vs root netem limit 100000 loss 1% seed 1234
netem.mem_jitter:
ip netns exec c tc qdisc replace dev vc root netem limit 100000 delay 20ms 15ms seed 4242
ip netns exec s tc qdisc replace dev vs root netem limit 100000 delay 20ms 15ms seed 4242
netem.reorder_dup:
ip netns exec c tc qdisc replace dev vc root netem limit 100000 delay 5ms reorder 25% 50% duplicate 1% seed 1234
ip netns exec s tc qdisc replace dev vs root netem limit 100000 delay 5ms reorder 25% 50% duplicate 1% seed 1234

setup.1350:
mount -o remount,rw /proc/sys 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p /dev/net; [ -c /dev/net/tun ] || mknod /dev/net/tun c 10 200
ip netns del c 2>/dev/null || true
ip netns del s 2>/dev/null || true
ip netns add c
ip netns add s
ip link add vc netns c type veth peer name vs netns s
ip -n c addr add 10.77.0.1/24 dev vc
ip -n s addr add 10.77.0.2/24 dev vs
ip -n c link set lo up
ip -n s link set lo up
ip -n c link set vc mtu 1350 up
ip -n s link set vs mtu 1350 up
ip -n c route add default via 10.77.0.2
ip -n s route add default via 10.77.0.1
